title: MLEADERSTYLE binary enum writer-domain validation

scope.operation: Refuse unsupported values for the selected MLEADERSTYLE enum fields before emitting the record.

fields.name: draw multi-leader order
fields.specification_meaning: 0 draws content first; 1 draws the leader first.

fields.name: draw leader order
fields.specification_meaning: 0 draws the leader head first; 1 draws the leader tail first.

fields.name: block content connection type
fields.specification_meaning: 0 connects to block extents; 1 connects to the block base point.

scope.authority: ODA Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1, §20.4.87, pp. 217-218; Autodesk MLEADERSTYLE DXF group-code table.
scope.claim_boundary: Writer-domain validation and emitted DXF fields only; no native MLeader rendering or whole-document support claim.

implementation: Validate groups 171, 172 and 177 against their documented 0..1 domains before the MLEADERSTYLE writer emits any bytes.
Preserve the existing field representations and valid values.

evidence.input: Runtime-generated typed MLEADERSTYLE objects; no fixture files committed.
evidence.refusal: Each invalid field value refuses before publication; the destination sentinel and caller model value remain unchanged.
evidence.retry: The same dx_iface retries after correcting the field to 0 or 1; the AC1027 output contains the exact selected group code/value.
evidence.matrix: Three independently mutated fields × two invalid values × two encodings; 12 destination-safe refusals and 12 successful retries.

remaining: Other MLEADERSTYLE integer, source-presence, repeated-field, version, dependency and native-rendering profiles remain open.
